Callout.Name: Organised Shoplifting
Callout.Message: Group filling bags and walking out of a store.
Callout.Advisory: Three of them, staff told not to intervene.

Script.Line: We are shopping. All four of us are shopping.
The bags are ours. They came in with us.
Nobody has walked out of anything. Nobody has left yet.

Lines.Approach: Three of them, bags full, and the staff have been told not to get involved. Which leaves it to you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
